candidates.snippet: 🔴 A man has been arrested after approaching the centre-left party leader Yair Golan with a knife in Tel Aviv

🔴 Israel's election committee said the turnout by noon was the highest since 1977.

Over 2.3 million Israelis cast their vote by noon, 31.5% of eligible voters.

🔴 Netanyahu has told his supporters that "left-wing women are escorting Arab women to the polls".

According to Haaretz, the prime minister sent voters a recorded message, accusing leftists and Palestinian-led parties of trying to "steal the election"
